content_of_post_to_answer: How do you address the fear of failure caused by high-functioning anxiety?
answer: High-functioning anxiety often turns fear of failure into a hidden performance strategy: you avoid mistakes by over-preparing, overthinking, and trying to control every outcome. The problem is that this protects your confidence at the cost of your growth. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my Quora profile for anyone who wants to go deeper. The goal is not to stop caring about failure, but to stop using fear as the only reason you move forward.
